# Langflow starter projects

The files below are starter projects from the Langflow repository, carried here unchanged, byte for byte, as test
input for the import of a Langflow flow.

- Repository: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow
- Commit: `504c02fc47e76087b82b0e7cbe4186e9cdd916d4`
- `Research Translation Loop.json` — path
  `src/backend/base/langflow/initial_setup/starter_projects/Research Translation Loop.json`
- `Basic Prompting.json` — path `src/backend/base/langflow/initial_setup/starter_projects/Basic Prompting.json`

`LICENSE` beside them is the repository's own `LICENSE` file at that commit, reproduced unchanged.
